dragons.name: Shaolin Dragon
dragons.description: Shaolin kung fu is one of the oldest and most famous martial arts. This dragon is a Shaolin warrior from the Buddhist Temple on the Songshan Mountain and has exceptional martial art skills.

dragons.name: Geckobolt Dragon
dragons.description: With only a handful of confirmed sightings deep in the jungle, the Geckbolt Dragon is an island myth whose existence is both supported and denied by many. Is it real and if so, what does it want?

dragons.name: Starhunter Dragon
dragons.description: The Starhunter Dragon will stop at nothing to collect a piece of every shooting star in the universe. The samples are used to power his space lasers, resulting in intense blasts that can scorch the battlefield. Don't get in his way!

dragons.name: Poseidon Dragon
dragons.description: Poseidon is usually quite calm and sleepy in the ocean. But if he gets angry, he starts generating tsunamis and earthquakes. Fun fact: He hates the taste of fish.

dragons.name: Super Terra Dragon
dragons.description: The Terra Dragon has always been very strong, but now that he’s three years old, he has become a Super Terra Dragon! If you try to touch him, we can't guarantee your safety.

dragons.name: Grass Dragon
dragons.description: The Grass Dragon’s favorite food is seaweed. He likes to have it for breakfast, lunch, and dinner and he doesn’t believe in sharing. Don’t try to steal a bite, he keeps a close count and will attack you if you do. Just a warning.

dragons.name: Freezox Dragon
dragons.description: This futuristic dragon has managed to use ice in a smart yet lethal way. His wings are made out of sharpened stalactites that never melt, because he generates cold that circulates from inside his chest to the rest of his body.

dragons.name: Underground Dragon
dragons.description: He's the underdog in this year's Tribal Tournament, it's the Underground Dragon. His competitors may not see him as a real threat, but could this finally be the year of the earth dwellers?

dragons.name: Clown Dragon
dragons.description: Although the Ringmaster Dragon usually keeps him in check, sometimes the Clown Dragon manages to escape... He loves to lurk in drains or sewers and offer unsuspecting young dragons a shiny red balloon.

dragons.name: Chosen Charm Dragon
dragons.description: The Chosen Charm Dragon studies enchanted objects. These charms can curse, damage, make you forget, or even fall in love... This powerful field of magic is often overlooked at the Dragon Academy!

dragons.name: Ride Dragon
dragons.description: If you think taxi services are good, check out the Ride Dragon. It knows the fastest routes around Dragon City and doesn’t need to stop for gas. It will pick you up from anywhere as long as you promise not to change the radio station.

dragons.name: Taj Mahal Dragon
dragons.description: The Taj Mahal Dragon loves to show off its ornate structure fused to its back. This masterpiece entices dragons from all over the Dragonverse to come and stare in wonder at this ancient creature... They are usually too amazed to even start a fight.

dragons.name: Colosseum Dragon
dragons.description: A brave gladiator who lives for the applause of the crowd, the Colosseum Dragon likes to put on a show when he destroys his enemies. He's trained his whole life for the ultimate battle and nothing will stop him earning his victory.

dragons.name: Maraca Dragon
dragons.description: "My name is Mara and I shake my maracas" is this dragon's famous catchphrase. She can be heard singing it in the parade, which she is a part of every year, of course!

dragons.name: Liberation Dragon
dragons.description: Sun's out, wings out! The Liberation Dragon lives for those long summer days when there's nowhere to be and nothing to worry about. That glowing orb? Just its good mood made visible.

dragons.name: Paradise Dragon
dragons.description: What happens when you put a dragon in paradise? It grows bright, light feathers, starts to glow like gold and is filled with eternal peace and tranquility unknown any other dragon.

dragons.name: Eggster Dragon
dragons.description: The Eggster Dragon doesn’t want to grow up. He’s even refusing to leave the egg he was born from! He just wants to eat chocolate and play with the Bunny Dragon for the rest of his life.

dragons.name: Fool's Treasure Dragon
dragons.description: What precious and opulent items could this dragon's treasure chest hold? Dragons from all over come to peek inside, however, don't be fooled... You can never unsee what lies within.

dragons.name: Dark Tharos Dragon
dragons.description: The Dark Tharos Dragon should come with a warning sign. He only eats, sleeps, and speaks of one thing: Battles! This enormous beast is dangerous, holds grudges, and knows the name of every enemy he’s destroyed in the arenas.

dragons.name: Starveton Dragon
dragons.description: One half of the Hunger Twins, the Starveton Dragon is an expert at using her skeletal form to her advantage. Unlike her brother, she works with what she's got – her ribcage proves especially useful when it comes to trapping prey...

dragons.name: Storm Dragon
dragons.description: This dragon loves stormy weather more than anything! If you feel that life is getting too peaceful in your island kingdom, get the Storm Dragon to shake things up.

dragons.name: Crossfire Dragon
dragons.description: Of all his impressive features, the Crossfire Dragon is most proud of the magic tattoos on his body. Each tattoo grants the dragon a different power. Added together, they make him a hard opponent to fight!

dragons.name: Motorbike Dragon
dragons.description: Get your dragon running and head out on the highway, looking for adventure and whatever comes your way!

dragons.name: Ironscales Dragon
dragons.description: The Ironscales Dragon was so ugly that everyone used to pick on him, until a blacksmith took pity and gifted him with an iron armor to hide his looks and protect him from constant aggravation. At the Metal Arena, his rivals get a taste of the sour character of his early days.

dragons.name: Koraken Dragon
dragons.description: The sea's most ornate creature, the Koraken Dragon loves to display its coral limbs to Dragon Masters! This species is, however, threatened by the Fuel Dragon and Crude Oil Dragon... It's time to release the Koraken and give them their comeuppance!

dragons.description: Potentially deadly, this dragon has to be treated with care to stop him from biting his master! When fully trained, he can be the most loyal servant.

dragons.name: Martial Arts Dragon
dragons.description: A master in Ansatsuken, the Martial Arts Dragon is always improving, no matter the difficulty, no matter the cost. He can't avoid fighting for the innocent whenever he sees injustice. He's the only one who has mastered the Hadoken technique.

dragons.name: Swamp Dragon
dragons.description: First you see it…now you don’t. You must be quick to spot this dragon. It loves to hide and is always on the lookout. It has an impeccable sense of sight and smell and can detect an enemy from miles away causing it to hide under water.

dragons.name: Purpureus Dragon
dragons.description: Known for having the prettiest eyes in the land, one glance and you'll be lost in a sea of purple. The Purpureus Dragon will hypnotize you with her beauty, right before she breathes glistening, yet scorching, purple fire!

dragons.name: Radiance Dragon
dragons.description: The Radiance Dragon doesn't just radiate light and warmth, it also exudes love and joy wherever it goes! Its lantern of hope has helped many a Dragon Master in their moment of need; when in doubt, give this friend a shout.

dragons.name: Destiny Dragon
dragons.description: The purest dragon of the Primal element! It is said that just by standing close to him, you can feel his aura of magic and power. The Destiny Dragon is something like a King of Dragonverse.

dragons.name: Sailer Dragon
dragons.description: Someone once made the mistake of throwing the Sailer Dragon a surprise party. Not a good idea. This dragon is always on guard and suspicious of everyone. Next time just give him a cake or else he’ll use his extra eyes to spy on you.

dragons.name: Chibi-Chief Dragon
dragons.description: The Chibi-Chief Dragon can be heard before he’s seen. This mighty dragon is not only a vicious attacker, but he’s also the ultimate lookout. He uses his distinctive call to warn his allies when he sees danger coming.

dragons.name: Pyramid Dragon
dragons.description: One of the 7 Wonders dragons, the Pyramid Dragon is an ancient beast that is worshipped by many. Each battle it wins gains it more power, pride, and followers...soon it'll have an army at its feet.

dragons.name: Pettalion Dragon
dragons.description: A battalion of lush, scarlet petals may look beautiful from afar, but Pettalion Dragons are a lot more ferocious when up close. They hunt in packs and will do anything to defend the Red Rose and their leader, the Warose Dragon.

dragons.description: This dragon is as mysterious as it gets! He's a whisper in the air, a light September breeze on your cheek, that shadow in the corner of your eye... Catch him, if you can!

dragons.name: Adamantium Dragon
dragons.description: The metal alloy he’s made of is indestructible. His long, flexible body allows him to trap all his rivals at once. Everyone knows there’s no way out of an adamantium knot!

dragons.name: Sustainable Dragon
dragons.description: By making small changes in the way we eat or use energy, we can begin to ease the pressure on our natural resources. This is the message that the Sustainable Dragon wants to convey.

dragons.name: Rideable Dragon
dragons.description: He used to be part of a carousel, but he hated that life, going around in circles all day, every day. One day he decided to escape and became a free dragon!

dragons.name: Broodby Dragon
dragons.description: Dragon City’s 10th Birthday collectible: The Broodby Dragon is a Tower Guardian whose warm and magic touch can make dragon eggs hatch much faster than usual. We don’t know how she does it–best not to question the ‘Egg Whisperer’!

dragons.name: Queen Dragon
dragons.description: The prettier counterpart of the power couple — Their Majesties King and Queen Dragon — is known for her peaceful and fair nature. Only the tricks of the evil witch will awaken her dark fury!

dragons.name: Peace Dragon
dragons.description: The Peace Dragon spreads love and peace all over Dragon City. Be careful, though! If you are not peaceful enough, you will suffer the consequences!

dragons.name: Nigiri Dragon
dragons.description: The Nigiri Dragon used to get really nervous before battles. But since focusing his energy, he’s now a ball of excitement and hard to beat. Most of the time this charming dragon wins just due to his pure joy.

dragons.name: Bull Dragon
dragons.description: Starting out life as an unusually large, browny baby, the Bull Dragon was used for sparring by older dragons, until he grew so powerful that they could no longer abuse him. Unfortunately, for them, he never forgets a face, and he is so obstinate that he will find them and make them pay.

dragons.name: Hidden Swamp Dragon
dragons.description: Hiding among the marshes, the Hidden Swamp Dragon is rarely sighted in the dry season. However, when the rain falls hard, you better watch out... Your raincoat won't save you from her muddy splashes!

dragons.name: Seahorse Dragon
dragons.description: This happy-go-lucky dragon adores the beach life and the sun! You can find him at all major surfing spots around Dragon City, splashing in the waves and bringing smiles to the faces of all creatures.

dragons.name: Paladin Dragon
dragons.description: The Paladin is a dragon made of epic adventures, noble deeds, and magical powers. He's one of the most well-behaved dragons of all time, yet has a peculiar weakness for hot dogs!

dragons.name: Elder Mountain Dragon
dragons.description: The grounded member of the Spirit Elders, the Elder Mountain Dragon may lack a sense of humor but it sure makes up for it in good advice and decision-making!

dragons.name: Wreath Dragon
dragons.description: Born with its tail around its precious golden star, the Wreath Dragon is always happy to get the party feeling festive! Other dragons come from all over to see their annual lights show, hundreds of Wreath dragons lighting up the sky!

dragons.name: Beakaneer Dragon
dragons.description: This buccaneer's long beak often gets him in trouble... The Beakaneer Dragon will talk and talk and never know when it's best to keep quiet. Did he incite the mutiny against the High Seven Dragon all those years ago?

dragons.description: If you thought northern lights were incredible, wait until you see this dragon fly around! She's both as cool as ice and as hot as fire and will never get tired of huffing and puffing.

dragons.name: Freezox Dragon
dragons.description: This futuristic dragon has managed to use ice in a smart yet lethal way. His wings are made out of sharpened stalactites that never melt, because he generates cold that circulates from inside his chest to the rest of his body.

dragons.name: Underground Dragon
dragons.description: He's the underdog in this year's Tribal Tournament, it's the Underground Dragon. His competitors may not see him as a real threat, but could this finally be the year of the earth dwellers?

dragons.name: Crested Fae Dragon
dragons.description: The Crested Fae Dragon helps to keep the water clean for the forests on the islands. Created from marsh plants, she contains sea minerals and acts as a natural filtration system. Just give her tons of fish friends and she’s happy.

dragons.name: Shapeshifter Dragon
dragons.description: An experiment gone wrong... After breaking out of the Genemancer's laboratory, the Shapeshifter Dragon is using its shapeshifting abilities to wreak havoc in Dragon City. Watch out, there may be an imposter amongst your dragons!
